steps.description: If the fibula is from the right leg, tick the "Right side leg" checkbox.

operations.description: Record whether the harvested fibula comes from the right leg so the fibula axis is oriented correctly.

steps.description: In the "Select mandibular segmentation" section, choose the mandibular segmentation.

operations.description: Select the segmentation node that contains the mandible.

steps.description: In the "Select fibula segmentation" section, choose the fibula segmentation.

operations.description: Select the segmentation node that contains the fibula.

steps.description: In the "Current Scalar Volume" option, choose the Mandible Volume.

operations.description: Select the current scalar volume (the mandible CT) used as background and for model generation.

steps.description: Click "Create bone models from segmentations" button.

operations.description: Create the mandible and fibula bone models from the selected segmentations.

steps.description: Change the layout to "Conventional".

operations.description: Switch the application layout to the built-in Conventional (four-up) layout.

steps.description: For the R (red) slice view, toggle ON "slice visibility in 3D view": render the red 2D slice plane inside the 3D view (the slice controller's eye/visibility button that shows the slice in 3D). This is a per-slice 3D-display toggle on the slice node.

operations.description: Turn on 3D display of the Red slice plane so it is rendered inside the 3D view.

steps.description: For the R (red) view, toggle on "FOV, Spacing match 2D" (adjusts slice resolution to match the 2D viewport pixel spacing).

operations.description: Enable the Red slice view's FOV/spacing-match-2D option so slice resolution matches the 2D viewport.

steps.description: In the toolbar, turn on "slice intersection visibility". In the slice intersection interaction options, turn on "set interaction", then enable both "Translate" and "Rotate".

operations.description: Show slice intersections in the views and enable their interactive translation and rotation.

steps.description: Manually adjust the slice intersection position by translate and rotate of the cross lines in each view.

operations.description: Manually translate and rotate the slice intersection cross lines in each view to position them.

steps.description: Click the "Add mandibular curve" button.

operations.description: Create the mandible curve markups node and enter place mode so the user can draw it.

steps.description: Configure the display settings of the mandibular curve created by the "Add Mandibular Curve" button. Specifically, in the "Markups" module, under the "Advanced" collapsible section, select "3D View 1" and "Red" in the "View" combo box.

operations.description: Restrict the mandible curve's display to 3D View 1 and the Red slice view (Markups module, Advanced section).

steps.description: Manually click and draw on the "Red" view to create a curve along the mandible.

operations.description: Draw the mandible curve by clicking along the mandible in the Red slice view.

interaction.placement_instructions: In the Red slice view, click along the mandibular bone to place control points of the mandible curve, following the mandible from one end to the other.

steps.description: Change the layout to "BoneReconstructionPlanner".

operations.description: Switch the application layout to the extension's BoneReconstructionPlanner layout.

steps.description: For the R (red) slice view, toggle OFF "slice visibility in 3D view": stop rendering the red 2D slice plane inside the 3D view (the same per-slice 3D-display toggle as step 7, set off).

operations.description: Turn off 3D display of the Red slice plane so it is no longer rendered in the 3D view.

steps.description: Manually set how many cut planes you want.

operations.description: Obtain the number of mandibular cut planes the user wants to create.

steps.description: Click "Add cut plane" button.

operations.description: Create a new mandibular cut plane markups node and enter place mode.

steps.description: Place one mandibular cut plane using the extension's Add cut plane workflow. If the user requested N cut planes, repeat the Add cut plane + place plane interaction N times.

operations.description: Place one mandibular cut plane in the views using the plane node created by the Add cut plane button.

interaction.placement_instructions: Place this plane, then click Done.

steps.description: Click "Add fibula line" button.

operations.description: Create the fibula line markups node and enter place mode.

steps.description: Draw a line over the fibula in "3D View 2", starting with the first point distally and the last point proximally.

operations.description: Draw the fibula line over the fibula in 3D View 2, distal point first and proximal point last.

interaction.placement_instructions: In 3D View 2, click the first control point of the fibula line at the distal end of the fibula and the second control point at the proximal end.

steps.description: Click "Reset field of view" button in the R (red) slice view.

operations.description: Reset the Red slice view field of view so the content is re-fitted.

steps.description: Click "Center fibula line using fibula model" button to align the line with the anatomical axis of the fibula.

operations.description: Center and align the fibula line along the fibula model's anatomical axis.

steps.description: Tick the "Automatic mandibular planes positioning for maximum bones contact area" checkbox.

operations.description: Enable automatic mandibular plane positioning for maximum bone contact area.

steps.description: Tick the "Make all mandible planes rotate together" checkbox.

operations.description: Enable rotating all mandibular planes together when one of them is adjusted.

steps.description: Enter the desired value in "Initial space (mm)".

operations.description: Obtain the initial space (mm) used when generating fibula planes.

steps.description: Enter the desired value in "Between space (mm)".

operations.description: Obtain the between space (mm) used when generating fibula planes.

steps.description: Click "Update fibula planes over fibula line; update fibula bone pieces and transform them to mandible" to generate the reconstruction and create the fibula cut planes.

operations.description: Generate the fibula cut planes from the fibula line, cut out the fibula bone pieces and transform them into the mandible.

steps.description: Tick the "Update fibula planes over fibula line; update fibula bone pieces and transform them to mandible" checkbox.

operations.description: Enable the check state of the generate/update button so the reconstruction updates when mandible planes move.

steps.description: In the BoneReconstructionPlanner module, in the "Mandible planes" row, toggle on the eye-icon tool button to show the mandibular cut planes.

operations.description: Show the mandibular cut planes by toggling on the eye-icon tool button in the Mandible planes row.

steps.description: In the same "Mandible planes" row, toggle on the axes-icon tool button to show the plane interaction handles.

operations.description: Show the interaction handles of the mandibular cut planes by toggling on the axes-icon tool button.

steps.description: Manually adjust the mandibular cut planes in the mandible 3D view by dragging the visible plane interaction handles.

operations.description: Manually adjust the mandibular cut planes in the 3D view by dragging their visible interaction handles.

interaction.placement_instructions: Manually adjust the mandibular cut planes in the 3D view by dragging their visible interaction handles.

steps.description: In the "Mandible planes" row, toggle off the eye-icon tool button to hide the mandibular cut planes.

operations.description: Hide the mandibular cut planes by toggling off the eye-icon tool button in the Mandible planes row.

steps.description: Clear the "Show original mandible model" checkbox.

operations.description: Clear the Show original mandible model checkbox so the original mandible model is hidden.
